release_notes: v1.2.1: Adds Parakeet Unified 0.6B as an optional English streaming model. When selected, ASR processes audio during recording without displaying partial transcripts; Stop flushes one final online result. Parakeet TDT v2/v3 remain full-recording, final-only decoders. Includes model selection, assisted download, and model-specific acoustic-vocabulary controls. ARM64-only; updates remain manual.
